name: ASAHI DIAMOND INDUSTRIAL INDIA PVT. LTD.
india_angle: Asahi Diamond Industrial India Pvt. Ltd. is the Indian subsidiary, indicating a strategic presence in the Indian market.
summary: Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacture and sale of diamond tools and abrasives, which are critical for precision machining and polishing in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are used in various stages of semiconductor fabrication, particularly in advanced packaging and automotive applications.
